review: PR300 actual loopback transport acceptance probe
result: PASS for bounded HTTP transport behavior only

coverage.runtime: Exact 3cad source modules imported from archive of published commit; module-origin assertions passed
coverage.transport: Actual Runtime start_server/uvicorn bound 127.0.0.1 with an ephemeral port; HTTPConnection and raw socket used; no public address or tunnel
coverage.storage: Existing test_service fixture used real temporary SQLite and FilesystemOutputProvider; no fake database/provider
coverage.positive: Authorized GET returned exact byte sequence loopback bytes 00 ff and expected content type, content length, no-store and nosniff headers
coverage.denials: Invalid installation key returned 403; unknown test credential remained 404 despite caller-supplied X-Actor-ID; wrong workspace and revoked grant returned generic 404 before additional provider opens
coverage.disconnect: A 16 MiB published output was requested over TCP; client closed after response headers; owned reader closed and process FD count returned to the pre-request count
coverage.shutdown: Each test stopped the Runtime server and joined its thread

trust_boundary: The test injected a trusted server-owned credential-to-Actor callback. This proves transport behavior only; it does not prove production identity authentication, Canvas integration, deployment wiring, public exposure, native/browser behavior, or full PR300 acceptance.

documentation_improvement.target: docs/skills/provenance-observability.md, Runtime output transport verification boundary
documentation_improvement.change: State that TestClient/ASGI tests prove in-process route semantics, while TCP streaming and disconnect claims require a loopback socket test; explicitly label a test-supplied Actor callback as transport-only evidence, not deployed authentication or Canvas integration.
documentation_improvement.reason: The existing exact-head tests cover route/service semantics and ASGI disconnect, but do not exercise an HTTP socket. The loopback probe supplies that distinct bounded evidence.
documentation_improvement.evidence: Published source commit 3cad4fd6d9fb386451b3b76d7b1103256eec54e; probe.py and pytest.log hashes above; two loopback tests passed.
documentation_improvement.limitations: No production authenticator, Canvas client, public endpoint/tunnel, native/browsers, deployment configuration, or hosted PR300 status is proven.

upstream_disposition: None; no upstream defect was found.
